entities.summary: The 2006 'Penguin Revolution' (high school students protesting education quality) and the massive 2011 student movement (led by figures including Camila Vallejo and Gabriel Boric) challenged Chile's privatized education system and broader inequality. These movements signaled growing dissatisfaction
